name: Inventory Asset
description: Main stock control account for inventory categories and item valuation.

name: Withholding Tax Receivable
description: WHT deducted by customers and recoverable from tax authority.

name: Accounts Payable
description: Trade payable control account for inventory suppliers.

name: Supplier Withholding Tax Payable
description: WHT deducted from supplier payments and payable to tax authority.

name: VAT Output
description: VAT collected on sales and payable to tax authority.

name: Inventory Adjustment Gain
description: Gains recognized from positive inventory adjustments.

name: Cost of Goods Sold
description: Cost recognized when inventory items are sold.

name: Inventory Shrinkage Expense
description: Losses from stock shrinkage, damage, or negative adjustments.

name: Freight and Landed Cost Expense
description: Freight and landed cost charges when expensed.
